info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Call Settings For Me With UserHub Phase2 API
Call Settings For Me With UserHub Phase2
Get Priority Alert Settings

items.docs:
Get Priority Alert Settings for the authenticated user.

Priority alert allows you to set up a unique ringtone based on predefined criteria. This is helpful, when the user wants to be quickly notified that a specific phone number is calling.

This API requires a user auth token with a scope of `spark:telephony_config_read`.

info.name: Get User (and Location) Schedules

items.docs:
Get Schedules for Call Settings for the authenticated user.

Schedules are used to define specific time periods which can be applied to various Call Settings, such as Sequential Ring, or Priority Alert. These call settings perform the defined actions based on the time frame in the schedule, making it more convenient for users to manage their calls.

This API requires a user auth token with a scope of `spark:telephony_config_read`.

info.name: Get Available Numbers for User's Location

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the maximum number of numbers in the response.

params.name: start
params.description: Specify the offset from the first result that you want to fetch.

params.name: name
params.description: List numbers whose owner name contains this string.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: List numbers whose phoneNumber contains this string.

params.name: extension
params.description: List numbers whose extension contains this string.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort the list of numbers based on `lastName`, `dn`, `extension` either asc or desc.

items.docs:
Get Available Numbers for User's Location.

Fetch all the numbers available in User's location.

This API requires a user auth token with a scope of `spark:telephony_config_read`.
